Episode 179. Unavoidable Trap (6)
"How did you know that Hister had been here?"
"You're saying something stupid again. Do you have to check to know that a mosquito has bitten your back? I am a part of the mother. And the soul of Hufester is composed of all the mother's power."
The power that Defus received from Rosa was exceeding Irina's expectations.
'Why not give it to me, why to the 4th period... So, the bloodline of Runckandel is the priority. Now?'
Defus seemed to see right through Irina, a sneer on his face.
"I wonder when you can shake off that arrogance... You and Joshua are very similar. You're full of greed with nothing but background, and you falter whenever things don't go as you think."
"Hmm, do you find me ridiculous now that I have received the power from the landlord?"
"Ridiculous. You're still thinking about reviving Heluram through the mother... You revere the mother, but you're not loyal to her. Your loyalty is still directed towards Heluram."
"Yes, yes. Think whatever you want."
"But, Prophet. Heluram will not wake up. Do you really think the mother wishes for the end of the world?"
"The end, that's something that can only inevitably happen in the process of the landlord becoming a perfect evil god..."
Irina's pupils widened.
"Could it be, are you saying the landlord doesn't plan to attain a complete divine form?"

"Yes. If the name Runckandel is not to disappear, people who remember and worship it are needed. A world of only ashes and dust is not worth ruling. You may believe that the instinct of the mother who became an evil god will eventually want the end, but if you keep doing so, you'll soon be in the same position as Joshua."
Slowly, Defus rose from his seat.
The eternal flame attached to his torso was still not extinguished.
"If you understand, stop wasting time holding a fire you can't handle, and do your job. The youngest will be here soon. He never misses an opportunity."

"......Our temporary cessation of invasion due to the flame that's attached to you can't be an opportunity for the 12th period. Even if they come to attack us here, we would still be overwhelmingly advantageous."

"I'm fed up now. This is why you and Joshua always end up getting hit by the youngest. This is a bigger crisis than ever. The mother cannot move, and the fire attached to me is likely not to go out until the youngest arrives. That means if a battle occurs, I could be pushed back by the youngest."
"You mean, you could lose?"
"Yes. So we need to set the board. Even if I lose, Runckandel shouldn't. A game board that doesn't lose."
Jin shared the information Valeria had brought with Beradin and Zephyrin.

"So the reason the Sword Garden stopped their human invasion is because you struck the 4th generation? Hister confirmed this by reading the record of the remaining dimensional gates in the Shul Republic."
"That's right."

"Although the main forces of the Sword Garden have shown to resurrect quickly even after death, the 4th generation has suffered injuries that couldn't recover for days... This is quite a special story. Their regeneration power should come from the evil god, has there been some problem?"
"Whether there is a problem or not. It's almost certain that the evil god can't heal the 4th generation at the moment. Now I understand why you, Jin, insisted on moving quickly."
Jin nodded at Beradin and Zephyrin's words.

"We're running out of time. If the 4th generation recovers, a large-scale invasion of humans through teleportation will start again. All the forces except ours have already been heavily hit, and we weren't able to respond properly. The only reason we didn't get hit was that they didn't invade. If we're invaded like this a few more times, the humans could be finished before we fight the evil god."
"So, this counterattack not only has to rescue prisoners, but also find a way to suppress their large-scale teleportation in the future?"
"Exactly, Beradin. If we can't find that this time, there is no future."

"We'll need to mobilize forces enough to call a full-scale war. Anyway, to bring back the rescued prisoners, the fleet power of each force is necessary. It would essentially become a rehearsal for the final battle with the evil god..."
"Not only the forces but also special technicians and researchers should go together. To find clues about large-scale teleportation."
In Giple, the top researchers and Beradin, Kinzel is already caught in the cold and Barvar and Orgal, and in Tikan, Valeria, Quaul, and Ratri had to directly join the front line.
"How about setting it at dawn in two days, Jin?"

"I think that would be good too. One of the maximum forces of the temporary alliance is my master, at least that much rest is needed to show a power fitting for a dignitary. I'm so tired now that I sent someone else to the meeting instead."
Jin nodded his head.
All that was left was to finalize the details of the operation and to hope that Defus wouldn't recover within two days.
On the morning of May 22, 1803, near the bow of the Puberty.

The time for the counterattack was nearing. Valeria had been keeping an eye on the dimensional gate of the Shul Republic, but fortunately, there was no record of the Dimension Gate of Chaos opening again.
[See, what did I tell you? I told you your flame is special. That guy named Defus must still be suffering from terrible pain.]
Veil spoke.
Jin, unsure how to respond to this tactless old knight, simply closed his mouth. Veil's voice must have reached Meri as well.
Meri did not react to Veil's words and kept her gaze on the dark sky.
The Tikan's participating personnel were currently waiting for Orgal while aboard Meri and Cosmos's fleet.
They had decided to move in one breath to the center of Licalten and the nearby Hufester Sea through his steel door.
"Youngest."
"Speak, sister."

"I'm saying this just in case, don't foolishly think about trying to save Defus brother somehow. Unlike Runtia sister, brother has already killed too many people. Even if it wasn't brother's intention."
Jin felt the same. At first, he wanted to save Defus somehow like Runtia, but now it was hopeless.

Above all, the current Defus is not an opponent who can afford to deal with half-heartedly. If they confronted him with a clumsy heart, the colleagues who were currently aboard this ship with him would be killed.
Like when they went to the Sword Emperor's Temple to save Dante, the Barmel Alliance currently had almost all their forces mobilized.

Starting from the survivors of Lunkandel, including Meri and the Tona brothers, to the key figures who were always on standby in Tikan, as well as numerous and armaments, a large force from the Empire also participated in the war.
Practically, everyone except Casimir and the King's direct defense force was heading for the battlefield.
"Uh, Master Jin. We won't be attacked in Tikan as soon as we arrive in Licalten, right?"
"We left the Red Owl to prepare for that, Enya. Valeria was reading the record of the dimensional gate until a while ago."
Kikantel answered Enya's question.

"Hoo, I'm still worried. Especially Yuria... Will she be okay? What if she collapses while we're not there, my heart isn't good. The king has to keep waiting for the situation, so he won't have the energy to take care of Yuria, and the teacher isn't a person who's good at comforting people."

"Beris has often shown that he gets along surprisingly well with Yuria. Finte and Kou are also there. So don't worry too much and just think about us successfully finishing the operation and returning."
"That's right, Enya. Don't forget that you're the head of the Tikan Magic Corps. If you can't concentrate, your subordinates will be more anxious."
Clang, Alisa checked her gauntlet and ruffled Enya's hair.
"Ugh, understood, Captain of the Defense."

"You may not have good memories of the Empire... but most of the imperial citizens captured in Licalten are weak and powerless, like you were. So let's save them and send them back to their everyday lives."

"Eh, do you think I'd be uncomfortable saving imperial people? I'm just worried about the Captain's daughter. It's disappointing if you see me like that! Even if there are nobles who have tormented me among the prisoners, it doesn't matter at all. Hmph, it's already overcome thanks to Master Jin."
"It's just a word, sweetheart. I know my Enya is kind the best."
"Okay, okay. Among those captured, there must be members of my official fan club and your unofficial fan club. As we're the presidents, we have to save them."
"Stop talking nonsense, Miss Sandra."
"Heodo, you can't call me by my real name where our members might be. You must call me Nodab Sarsang, got it? So my mystique won't be compromised."
"Hoo."
"Anyway, Orgal is late... I hope it's not a hitch in the operation."
Balkas said, looking at the wall clock.
3:07 in the morning.
Just seven minutes late, but given the scale of the operation, he was becoming impatient.
Unlike Tikan, who uses Orgal's dimension door, Zifl and Kinselo's fleets were directly flying to Licalten.

When Zifl's fleet (which also included Imperial forces) reaches the northern border of Licalten, and Kinselo's fleet (which had Bigung and Moomyeong on board) reaches the west, Orgal was to divide Tikan's forces to the central and sea of Licalten.
Tick tock, tick tock, splash...!
As the scheduled time continued to be delayed, the waves stained the night sky kept breaking on the fleet.
After more than 30 minutes passed and the anxiety of the entire fleet began to grow, finally a giant steel door was seen forming in mid-air.
"Orgal!"
Orgal, who had come out of the steel door, already looked quite tired.
[I guess everyone was worried because I'm late. There's no problem with the operation. Rather, there's good news.]
"Good news?"
When Jin asked, Orgal nodded his head.

[I went for an additional reconnaissance because I had a bad feeling, and during that process, the energy of the evil god had a fit of rage. The delay happened because the rest of the allies waited for the aftermath to subside before entering.]
"How is that good news?"

[That fit is like the evil god's mumbling, Jin. The evil god is currently unable to operate for some reason... maybe due to despair. It must have flinched momentarily at the external stimulus of intrusion. This means that the possibility of the evil god appearing directly in this battle is very low.]
